dependencies.python: numpy (installed) for numpy.random.default_rng. No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - Kernel files: scheduler.py, clock.py, events.py, interfaces.py, context.py, termination.py, checkpoint.py, engine.py. No others. - No pydantic in runtime objects; frozen dataclasses for Event/Decision/Action/ExecutionResult. - Only ctx.rng for randomness. Kernel itself draws nothing; it only owns and checkpoints the generator. - Registry preserves registration order; never sorts. - Phase enum order is the only source of truth; PHASES is derived from it; PHASE_ORDER_VERSION = 1. - Unknown action target is a hard error (KernelError), not a skip. - All stubs live in tests/kernel_stubs.py; no stub or example subsystem under src/. - Python 3.12-compatible syntax. - AC 13 grep must be run and its output pasted; it is the purity gate.

interfaces.interface: steps_run: int; terminated_by: str; events: list[Event]; decisions: list[Decision]; checkpoints: list[Path]

register(sub) (raises on duplicate name); get(name); by_phase(phase) -> list; sources() -> list[ActionSource]; targets() -> list[ActionTarget]; find(protocol) -> Subsystem | None
write_checkpoint(ctx, path: Path) -> None ; sorted-key JSON
As given verbatim in story Dev Notes.

tests.standards: pytest; one test module per kernel module (test_scheduler.py, test_clock.py, test_events.py, test_context.py, test_termination.py, test_checkpoint.py, test_engine.py). Stubs in tests/kernel_stubs.py. Determinism tests compare lists/bytes, not "roughly equal".
